title: Implement lock-light capture metrics snapshots
description:
Create a lightweight metrics snapshot structure and updater that the realtime PipeWire callback can write to without blocking, and that the UI or session layer can read atomically.

Before editing, inspect:
- Any existing headers under src/audio/ for naming conventions and namespace.
- The realtime callback constraints documented in the phase C risk notes: publish must not block or allocate.

Do not infer APIs, schemas, behavior, or file contents; inspect the referenced files first.

Implement CaptureMetrics with:
- A plain-old-data snapshot struct (CaptureMetricsSnapshot) containing: frames captured, peak sample value (per channel or mono), RMS level, overflow count, underrun count, xrun count, and a monotonic timestamp.
- An atomic publisher that the realtime callback can update with a single relaxed or release store (no mutex, no allocation). Use a double-buffer, sequence-lock, or atomic struct swap pattern.
- A reader method that the non-realtime side calls to get the latest consistent snapshot. The reader may spin-retry on a sequence counter but must not block the writer.
- Keep the struct trivially copyable and small enough for cache-line-friendly access.
- Do not include Qt, PipeWire, libsndfile, or FLAC headers. This is a pure C++ concurrency primitive.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: src/audio/CaptureMetrics.hpp exists and declares CaptureMetricsSnapshot and an atomic publisher/reader class
CaptureMetricsSnapshot is trivially copyable (static_assert or equivalent enforced in code)
The publish/update path uses no std::mutex, no dynamic allocation, and no blocking calls
The read path returns a consistent snapshot without blocking the writer
Snapshot includes at minimum: frames captured, peak level, overflow count, underrun count, and timestamp fields
No #include of Qt, PipeWire, libsndfile, or FLAC headers appears in either file
g++ -std=c++20 -fsyntax-only src/audio/CaptureMetrics.cpp -I src passes or cmake --build build compiles the unit
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify any file outside src/audio/CaptureMetrics.hpp and src/audio/CaptureMetrics.cpp
include Qt, PipeWire, libsndfile, or FLAC headers
use std::mutex or blocking synchronization in the publish path

allowed: choose between sequence lock, double buffer, or atomic struct swap
choose mono peak vs per-channel peak representation
choose relaxed vs release/acquire memory ordering for publish
forbidden: introduce a logging or tracing framework
use heap allocation in the publish path
